author: CBR
description:
Good Luck, Have Fun, Don’t Die stars Sam Rockwell as a man who says he’s back from the future. He walks into a Los Angeles diner, starts recruiting a team, and warns them that the mission to save the world will get most of them killed. 

This Short breaks down the movie’s core setup and why it is the kind of original, theatrical movie worth showing up for.
